basic_info.description: Stunning 1912 fully detached residence with brilliant natural light, open concept floor plan, and sunny on the level walk out rear yard. There are 3 beautiful bedrooms including a sophisticated primary suite and 2 fully renovated travertine baths on the top living level plus a cozy west facing outdoor deck (Ask for architect plan drawing for an easy conversion to 4 Bedrooms). The main level boasts a gorgeous living room with exceptional period detail and fireplace on center. Two steps up you will find a perfect informal dining area, family room and chef's kitchen with custom cabinetry and marble island. The rear of the home connects intimately, on the level with a rear patio, border gardens and tiered area with private bamboo surround. The garage hosts 1 car plus two more cars fit in the driveway in front of the garage door.
